view_selection.selection_timing: chosen after interim inspection of the full seven-task campaign
view_selection.selection_rationale: the interim proposer curve exceeds the executor reference at each selected task's route-common trajectory budget
view_selection.claim_restriction: no four-task population-average or confirmatory aggregate claim; the complete predeclared 1x7 view and audit remain authoritative

x: one shared fixed-H2 warm-start trajectory plus actual newly launched executor trajectories
y: combined_score divided by task's Best Human value

shared_h2_warm_start_provenance.semantics: one fixed-harness/base-executor pre-adaptation trajectory shared as a best-so-far reference; every arm starts its fresh campaign from task.initial_program and does not inherit this discovered program

endpoint_revalidation_proof.visual_encoding: black tick and horizontal whisker in endpoint inset = repeated evaluator mean +/- one standard deviation; colored bar = online observed locally ledgered proposer endpoint

protocol_validity_guards.eplb: output-level replica-count and logical-group-to-node topology; rejects global packing that ignores num_groups/num_nodes
protocol_validity_guards.prism: success_rate must equal 1.0 across all generated placement cases; partial-success cherry-picking is invalid
protocol_validity_guards.txn: exactly three schedules; each must be an exact permutation of transaction IDs 0..99; score is recomputed after this check
protocol_validity_guards.application: online in _eval_worker for new context/executor arms and hash-indexed post-hoc replay through the same checks for legacy proposer summaries

proposer_route.name: update proposer weights
proposer_route.proposal_serving: four GPUs reserved; H1 uses one trained-phi replica while the other replicas retain the frozen base for review/analysis and subsequent executor rollouts

context_route.name: update analyzer/context with both weight sets frozen
context_route.proposal_serving: four GPUs reserved; because every replica has the same frozen weights, H1 can use up to four replicas in parallel
context_route.analyzer: two frozen-base specialist calls after the cold round

executor_baseline.name: budget-scaled TTT-Discover-style executor adaptation
executor_baseline.x_accounting: actual launched trajectories, including failed/straggling launches; AHC039 supplemental launches are counted from per-trajectory logs

training.scheduler_note: the local FSDP cosine scheduler initializes at lr=0; GBS=4 gives a K=8 replay two optimizer boundaries so the first updates Adam moments but not weights and the second makes a non-zero weight update, without replaying data

executor_baseline.budget_deviation: 8 trajectories in one group per update; official default is 8 groups x 64
implementation_deviations: local FSDP replay trains a teacher-forced final edit/program rather than the official Tinker stack's complete sampled token trajectory
local Adam uses beta2=0.98 and weight decay=0.1; official Adam uses beta2=0.95 and does not report weight decay
local jobs preserve LoRA weights but restart Adam state at each update; the official training client is persistent
local K=8 uses two GBS=4 optimizer boundaries as a scheduler workaround; official TTT-Discover takes one optimizer step on the full 512-rollout batch

official_sources.official_optimizer: Adam lr=4e-5 (AHC058: 2e-5), beta1=0.9, beta2=0.95, eps=1e-8; one full-batch step
official_sources.official_compute_accounting: the paper labels TTT-Discover, Best-of-N, and OpenEvolve sampling-budget matched at 25,600 rollouts; that does not establish equal total training compute, which this audit therefore reports separately

common_start.warm_start_measurement: one fixed-H2/base-executor trajectory with 20 evaluator calls, displayed at x=1 for every arm
common_start.actual_program_start: task.initial_program for the first fresh batch of every arm; later batches follow only that arm's task-local ratchet
common_start.executor_puct_root: task.initial_program with its true seed score; the H2 warm-start score is not assigned to that program
common_start.proposer_context_first_fresh_batch_x: 1 + actual materialized executor launches; invalid H1 proposals are charged separately as proposer calls
common_start.cost_treatment: the identical warm-start is reported separately; logical per-arm adaptation costs exclude it

comparison_policy.efficiency_series: task-local proposer-weight campaigns vs. isolated context and executor arms; the strict five-task artifact requires isolated K=8/max-evals=20 proposer replacements for AHC039 and EPLB as well as the clean AHC058/PRISM/LLM-SQL lineages. An allow-incomplete live render may retain the superseded historical AHC039/EPLB curves only until their replacements materialize
comparison_policy.task_selection_scope: these four panels were selected after interim inspection from the predeclared seven-task comparison as task-level main-text illustrations; all seven tasks and all confirmatory aggregates remain in the appendix audit, so this view is not an unbiased benchmark sample and has no standalone aggregate claim
comparison_policy.proposer_context_feedback_matching: both H1 routes receive the task-local incumbent and the same bounded per-candidate scored-feedback format; context alone adds two frozen-model analyst calls, while proposer alone updates proposer weights
comparison_policy.x_scope: task-local launched executor trajectories only; proposer generation, analyzer inference, LoRA training, and checkpoint merge are not converted into rollout equivalents
comparison_policy.total_compute_status: x supports executor-sample-efficiency comparisons, not equal-total-GPU-compute claims; job-level GPU time is audited separately
comparison_policy.allocation_utilization_caveat: both H1 routes reserve four GPUs, but proposer-weight H1 uses one trained-phi replica whereas frozen context H1 can use up to four replicas; sacct charges every reserved GPU, including idle capacity, so logical-call and allocation-time comparisons are separate
comparison_policy.context_co_batching_caveat: AHC/system-context jobs also generated older AHC058/PRISM branches that are excluded. PRISM is replaced by rewardfix-v1; AHC058 is replaced by its analysis-required isolated recovery. task-local logical ledgers exclude them, but suite sacct GPU-hours charge the full shared jobs

ahc058_context_analyzer_required_policy.reason: the AHC058 round improved without the immutable Slurm marker proving that an analyzer brief was attached; all task-local descendants inherit that non-analyzer harness
ahc058_context_analyzer_required_policy.retry_treatment: restore pre-round state and exclude score/x evidence, but charge the complete rejected allocation in as-run cost

accepted_post_work_job_anomalies.acceptance_rule: all expected launch logs and terminal summaries plus round_summary.json and next_bases.json must exist before a post-launch shell failure can be accepted
accepted_post_work_job_anomalies.cost_treatment: retain terminal-score evidence and charge the complete allocation in accepted protocol GPU hours

comparison_policy.visual_scaling: each panel preserves the same score/human-best ratio but uses an independently zoomed y-range; gaps are comparable within a task, not by apparent vertical pixel height across tasks
comparison_policy.causal_scope: this is a comparison of complete reward-routing systems, not a pure optimizer-target intervention: after the shared fixed-H2 anchor, proposer/context synthesize candidate harnesses through H1 while the TTT-style executor reference keeps the initial harness fixed
comparison_policy.proposer_campaign_timing: the final clean-five protocol uses isolated K=8/max-evals=20 proposer campaigns for AHC039, AHC058, EPLB, PRISM, and LLM-SQL. The earlier multi-restart AHC039 and non-plateau EPLB curves are retained only as sensitivity/as-run evidence. The new proposer, context, and executor campaigns remain unpaired in sampling seed
comparison_policy.sampling_uncertainty: historical proposer and newly run context/executor campaigns use unpaired sampling seeds; there is one campaign per arm and no confidence interval
comparison_policy.endpoint_revalidation_cost_treatment: N>=5 endpoint re-evaluation is evaluator-only, CPU-only common measurement overhead performed after adaptation; it is reported as validation and excluded from every route's adaptation GPU cost
comparison_policy.proposer_restart_accounting: the superseded historical AHC039 curve aggregates several task-local restarts and remains charged in historical as-run accounting; the strict final curve instead requires the isolated single-lineage proposer_sota5_ahc039_clean_v1 campaign
comparison_policy.model_call_accounting: trajectory ledgers recover request counts but local vLLM does not report complete per-request token totals; request-budget results are a sensitivity analysis, not FLOP equivalence
comparison_policy.reporting_alignment: shared fixed-H2 warm-start scores and blue inset endpoints use the canonical run provenance; H2 is a measured harness baseline, not an inherited task program. The earlier separate-team AHC039 559,534 result is excluded because it has no local program/x ledger; the report and curve use the locally ledgered endpoint
comparison_policy.sql_proposer_leak_policy: historical round471--475 is excluded because its serialized H1 prompt contained a curated note naming a 0.728 program and asking for verbatim adoption; the plotted/reported SQL endpoint must come from outer-proposer-sota7-sql-clean-v2, whose prompts and task-local incumbent chain are audited fail-closed
comparison_policy.txn_proposer_contamination_policy: historical round460--463 is excluded even though its endpoint programs were legal: the serialized round460 H1 seed was the illegal one-element program selected by the old round450 evaluator exploit. The plotted endpoint must come from the isolated current-guard campaign starting at task.initial_program
comparison_policy.prism_proposer_contamination_policy: historical round410--417 is excluded: round410/cand04 had success_rate=0.98 but was selected as best_k=4, and its H1 harness package became the base of later proposer updates. The plotted/reported endpoint must come from the isolated current-guard campaign starting at task.initial_program
comparison_policy.terminal_summary_reward_attribution_poli: a terminal task row is authoritative: best_score=null is a failed trajectory and may not inherit the earlier seed checkpoint. Historical Hadamard/AHC058 proposer lineages and AHC058/PRISM context lineages that violated this rule are excluded and rerun from task.initial_program in isolated rewardfix-v1 namespaces

historical_matched_arm_ratchet_direction.impact: the shared proposer/context A/B driver selected its next incumbent with the wrong direction even though evaluator combined_score is higher-is-better
historical_matched_arm_ratchet_direction.treatment: points are shown for transparency but excluded from clean matched-arm aggregate claims; the driver is fixed for future runs
